Observations at several places of a PAN by a front right passenger. Avenue BLANQUI in BOGNY-SUR-MEUSE district of LEVERZY (the exit of the turn at the railway station of LEVREZY) the witness observes in the sky a rectangle illuminated with white lights. A little further, when the witness exits the car, he sees red and white lights over the wood of LEVREZY the shape then looks more like a diamond. The witnesses continue their journey and then stop again. The standing witness sees at eye height above the trees an ovoid shape with round red lights and orange glows. The witness is afraid because it seems to him that the PAN is coming towards her.

The witness observed in the sky the presence of 3 lights aligned horizontally, with the arrival a few minutes later of 2 additional lights in vertical position, all forming a "L". No movement, movement or change of luminous intensity during the entire observation period. No aircraft passes in this area, however, with several airway crossings (near Lyon, Geneva, Annecy and Chambéry). The witness made a somewhat similar observation on 18 April 2017. At 3am, light resembling the lighthouse of an airplane appeared on the horizon above the mountains and approached. The light stopped and then moved back to disappear and reappeared a few minutes later to stop in the sky for more than 30 minutes. She accelerated and disappeared in less than a few seconds.

fr: Original French account from GEIPAN:

Le témoin observe dans le ciel la présence de 3 lumières alignées horizontalement, avec l'arrivée quelques minutes plus tard de 2 lumières supplémentaires en position verticale, le tout formant un « L ». Pas de mouvement, ni de déplacement ni de changement d'intensité lumineuse pendant toute la durée de l'observation. Pas de passage d'avion dans cette zone, comportant pourtant plusieurs points de passage de routes aériennes (proximité des zones d'approche de Lyon, de Genève d'Annecy et de Chambéry). Le témoin a fait une observation un peu similaire le 18 avril 2017. À 3h du matin lumière ressemblant au phare d'un avion est apparue à l'horizon au-dessus des montagnes et s'approchant. La lumière s'est arrêté puis à reculé jusqu'à disparaître et est réapparue quelques minutes plus tard pour s'immobiliser dans le ciel pendant plus de 30 minutes. Elle a accéléré et a disparu en moins de quelques secondes. GEIPAN classification C: unidentified — insufficient data. Observation details: date 2017-04-22; location AMBERIEU-EN-BUGEY.
